name: Focused Fan-out
description: Partitions the mapped source context into explicit worker assignments before merge, summary, and reviewer-gated delivery.

nodes.title: Scope contract
nodes.description: Freeze the repository snapshot, direct audit scope, exclusions, runtime configuration, and target identity.

nodes.title: Source assignments
nodes.description: Partition the explicit source inventory into narrow worker assignments for this opt-in workflow.
nodes.prompt: Partition the source inventory into concrete file-level assignments without claiming audit coverage.

nodes.title: Focused investigation
nodes.description: Assign one narrow task per source object and retain every task input, output, and agent attribution.
nodes.prompt: Investigate only the assigned source object. Return distinct source-grounded hypotheses and follow dependencies only as needed.

nodes.title: Canonical candidates
nodes.description: Merge identical candidate root causes, retain provenance, and prepare the round summary.
nodes.prompt: Merge only identical root causes. Never invent a finding that is absent from the discovery records.

nodes.title: Human review
nodes.description: Require explicit reviewer decisions for validity, impact, duplicates, remediation, and risk acceptance.

nodes.title: Regression baseline
nodes.description: Compare stable root-cause fingerprints and evidence revisions across target-scoped runs.

nodes.title: Delivery package
nodes.description: Produce reviewer-approved reports, machine-readable exports, and remediation handoff artifacts.
